purpose: Per-stage executed evidence for the five task-route CT cases this card mapped (T05's CT03/CT04/CT05 and T06's CT17/CT18). Written in the shape docs/reports/remaining-t00/coverage.json uses for mapped_case_stage_matrix, and alongside docs/reports/remaining-t03-ct-integration/ct_stage_evidence.json, so a future stage-derived summarizer can merge the three files instead of hand-maintaining the aggregate. T00's coverage.json is an archived audit at revision ea2af0f and is deliberately not rewritten here.
derivation_rule: A stage is `executed` only where a named workspace test runs it on the case's own artifact. A control fixture's execution is recorded under aux:, never as the case's own stage. A stage a refused program never reaches is `not_applicable`, not `unassessed`.
route: task route (qcore_frontend::source_tasks -> qcore_core::scoped_tasks / task_execution -> qcore_core::task_c_emit), in its ScopedReadSharesV1 and ScopedErrorPayloadV1 profiles
route_reads_cfg_as_the_task_ir: The manifest note states the task-route reading: `cfg` names the checked task IR, which these fixtures really construct. That is why every task-route native case claims it (CT01, CT13, CT16 and now CT03/CT17) and why the mutex route never does. Card T05 section 9 proposed `cfg: unassessed` for CT03; this card records the deviation deliberately in its README section 2.

CT11.measured: Q600 LoanOutstanding { resource: 1, outstanding: 512, borrowers: [3] } at the write placed between the two joins.
CT11.reason_left_unmapped: The scenario reads 'full permission reconstructed while local shared aliases survive'. ScopedReadSharesV1 has no local alias form at all, and the party retaining the share here is an unjoined child task. The refusal direction matches, but the retaining party does not, so mapping it would claim intra-frame alias evidence the corpus does not have. T05 flagged exactly this and left the decision to the integrator.
CT11.unblocks_when: an owned-pointer alias form exists in the grammar (the same gap that keeps CT06 unmapped).

CT06.reason_left_unmapped: `let copy = buffer;` is refused with 'owned buffers require explicit move or a checked buffer read'. The closest measured fact is that both children receive the same pointer, which is evidence for CT03's acceptance, not for a copy the grammar does not admit.

CT35.proposed_by: not proposed (T05 section 9 and T08 section 8)
CT35.reason_left_unmapped: ScopedReadSharesV1 has no byte-size accounting: 'count its live bytes once' is discharged as one allocation counted once, measured by address. FlatEpochBoundV1 checks the 4096 rule at model level, but there is no epoch source syntax, hence no parser stage and no reference execution.
